title: Four-Way Stop: Who Goes First?
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 7 · Right-of-Way Rules · Intersections. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/laws-and-rules-of-the-road/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: You and the blue car stop together. Who goes first?

choices.label: Let the blue car go first

safeOutcome: When two cars stop together, yield to the car on your right. Blue goes, then you; gray arrived later.
unsafeOutcome: Blue was on your right. When you stop together, blue goes first—even when both cars are going straight.
